description: This Java source file defines the StatusInfo class, which models health status information including status codes, details, and hierarchical child statuses. It includes methods for creating, merging, and serializing status objects, as well as handling JSON conversion.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Enumeration of health status codes: UNKNOWN, UP, DOWN, with merge logic.

classes.name: StatusInfo
classes.description: Immutable class representing health status with details, children, and optional label; supports JSON serialization/deserialization and status merging.

methods.name: mergeWith
methods.description: Merges this status with another status, returning the combined status.

methods.name: fromStatus
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo instance from a Status enum value.

methods.name: fromDetail
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo from a single StatusDetailMessage, computing status.

methods.name: fromDetails
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo from a collection of StatusDetailMessages, computing status.

methods.name: composite
methods.description: Creates a composite StatusInfo from a list or map of child StatusInfos, computing overall status.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns the list of status details.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the list of child StatusInfo objects.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Creates a copy of StatusInfo with a new label.

methods.name: isComposite
methods.description: Checks if the StatusInfo has child statuses.

methods.name: addDetail
methods.description: Returns a new StatusInfo extended with an additional detail, possibly changing status.

methods.name: isHealthy
methods.description: Determines if the status is considered healthy (not DOWN).

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the StatusInfo to a JSON object.
